offence_note: Six robberies with imitation firearm, assault causing bodily harm, restricted firearm possession
co_offenders: Traviss: apparently same joint-submission sentence, 7y5m less credit
sentence_quote: I will reduce that sentence from 10 years five months to seven years five months.
note: Joint submission; totality reduction; ancillary orders not shown; Traviss sentence assumed same.

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted. The appeal is allowed and the appellant will be credited an additional 214 days toward his sentence.
note: Appeal only increased pre-sentence credit for hospital time by 214 days.

offence_note: Knife-point robbery of $80, assault and threats
sentence_quote: reduce the sentence to fifteen months minus pre-sentence custody credited on the 2 for 1 basis including the fourteen days that was not counted by the trial judge, totalling 208 days credit.
Accordingly, the sentence appeal is dismissed.
note: Custodial term less than three years, exact length not shown; offence not shown.

offence_note: Fraud over $5,000 using empty ATM deposits
sentence_quote: was sentenced to a term of imprisonment of six months plus probation, which term of imprisonment works out to 14 months on the basis that double credit was given for time served pre-sentence.
note: Appeal dismissed as to jail; one probation condition sentence deleted.

sentence_quote: I would accede to the accused's request for an extension of time for bringing the application for leave to appeal, and would grant leave to appeal. However, there being some reasonable basis for the imposition of the impugned conditions, I would dismiss the appeal.
note: Appeal challenged alcohol probation conditions only; dismissed.

sentence_quote: I conclude that an appropriate sentence, given the gravity, the high degree of moral blameworthiness, is a sentence of five years incarceration.
note: Additional 60 days credit for Covid conditions; SOIRA 20 years.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm on partner and infant son; uttering threat
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed. The sentence imposed by the Sentencing Judge is set aside, and the terms of the joint recommendation shall be substituted therefor.
note: Joint recommendation of consecutive CSOs totalling 16 months substituted for 12 months custody.

offence_note: Breach-of-trust theft over $5,000 from care home
sentence_quote: I find that it would be in Ms. MacIntosh’s interests and not contrary to the public interest that Ms. MacIntosh be discharged conditionally.
note: Conditional discharge with 24 months probation; $200 surcharge.

offence_note: Assault with a weapon and uttering a threat
sentence_quote: the appeal should be allowed, but only to the extent of reducing the sentence for assault with a weapon to 11 months, and the sentence for uttering a threat to a one day concurrent to take account of the credit for time served.
note: Credit raised from 8 to 13 months; probation follows jail.

offence_note: Armed robberies, hostage-taking with firearm, weapons offences
sentence_quote: In my judgment, the sentence of life imprisonment imposed by the trial judge for the hostage-taking offence was a fit sentence in the circumstances of this case and this offender.
note: Life sentence kept; robbery sentences cut 12y to 8y, count 5 made concurrent.
